description:
Perform a security audit by identifying all visits from the competitor company 'Nexus Industries'. 

1. Open the Visitor Log or Reports section in Jolly Lobby Track.
2. Filter the records to show ONLY visitors from 'Nexus Industries'.
3. Export this specific list to a CSV file named 'nexus_audit.csv' in the 'Documents' folder (/home/ga/Documents/nexus_audit.csv).
   (If CSV export is not available, printing to a PDF file named 'nexus_audit.pdf' or a text file is acceptable, provided it contains ONLY the correct records.)
